decision: M03b Gen 5 species abilities with owner exceptions, approved 2026-09-11
setting: P_UPDATED_ABILITIES GEN_LATEST -> GEN_5, plus 18 pinned exceptions

selector_audit.method: Static scan of game/src/data/pokemon/species_info/*.h for every P_UPDATED_ABILITIES selector, resolved against GEN_5.
selector_audit.unchanged_breakdown: 91 gated on >= GEN_4 stay true, so the Gen 4/5-era ability updates are retained.
selector_audit.affected_breakdown: 21 gated on >= GEN_6, 15 on >= GEN_7, 2 on >= GEN_8, 5 on >= GEN_9.
selector_audit.resolution: 25 of the 43 take the Black 2/White 2 set; 18 are pinned to the present-day set as owner exceptions.
selector_audit.direction_note: The switch is not one-way. Gen 5 removes later additions (weather setters, Neutralizing Gas, Sharpness, Competitive, Protean, Reckless, Frisk, Anticipation) but also restores abilities later removed (Gengar Levitate, Litwick line Shadow Tag, Zapdos Lightning Rod, legendary beast absorbing abilities, Piplup line Defiant, Shiftry Early Bird, Venipede line Quick Feet).
selector_audit.gen_6_plus_entries_reached: None. No Mega form, no Gigantamax form and not Sylveon carries a P_UPDATED_ABILITIES selector; Mega Gengar has its own entry and does not read GENGAR_ABILITIES.

kept_present_day.agent_judgment: The owner named the four weather setters, Weezing and Gallade. Pre-evolutions and same-line members were included so no evolution line is half Gen 5 and half present-day; this is a routine reversible choice and is reversible per species.

overridden_away_from_gen_5: GENGAR Cursed Body instead of restored Levitate
LITWICK / LAMPENT / CHANDELURE Infiltrator instead of restored Shadow Tag

limits: Static selector scan plus runtime assertions over sampled species; not an exhaustive per-species historical database audit
How the player obtains Hidden Abilities is still undecided, so several pinned hidden abilities may be unreachable in play
Weather-setter abilities change battle pacing; gym leader and trainer teams have not been designed or rebalanced around them
Learnsets, move power/accuracy/PP and species experience yields remain inherited and unapproved
The existing linker RWX warning is unchanged; this is not a warning-free or release certification
No full playthrough, menu pass or five-region progression balance
